about: AniCal's mascot: a felt mascot costume with a calendar-page head. Made with a local ComfyUI. The base image was generated with Z-Image Turbo, and each pose is an instruction edit of the base with Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 (Lightning 4-step LoRA, 4 steps, CFG 1, shift 3.1) followed by BiRefNet background removal. All five poses were then cropped to one shared box (x 68-751, y 29-1210 of 832x1216) and scaled to 640 px tall, so the mascot keeps the same scale and position on every step.

base.prompt: full body photo of a woman performer in a Japanese mascot costume, human adult body proportions with a curvy hourglass figure, wide hips, full bust, narrow waist and long legs, wearing a skin-tight one-piece bodysuit made of soft cream white felt with red felt piping at the collar, cuffs and waist, red felt gloves and red felt ankle boots, and an oversized plush mascot head twice the size of a normal head shaped like a square tear-off calendar page with a red felt header band and two silver binder rings on top like ears, big sparkly purple anime eyes, rosy pink felt cheeks, small happy smile, soft felt fabric texture with visible stitching, standing in a friendly pose waving one hand, wholesome, front view, centered, entire figure visible from head to boots, isolated on a plain flat light grey background, no shadow, no text
